SELECT idcase, activity, COUNT(*) AS rework_count FROM ( SELECT idcase, activity, LAG(activity) OVER (PARTITION BY idcase ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_activity FROM event_log ) WHERE activity = prev_activity GROUP BY idcase, activity HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT e1.idcase, julianday(e2.timestamp) - julianday(e1.timestamp) AS time_diff_days FROM event_log e1 INNER JOIN event_log e2 ON e1.idcase = e2.idcase WHERE e1.activity = 'Permit submitted by employee' AND e2.activity = 'Permit approved by administration' AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp

SELECT DISTINCT resource FROM event_log WHERE activity IN ('Declaration approved by budget owner', 'Declaration rejected by budget owner', 'Permit approved by budget owner', 'Permit rejected by budget owner')

SELECT e1.idcase, e1.activity, e1.timestamp, e2.timestamp FROM event_log e1 JOIN event_log e2 ON e1.idcase = e2.idcase AND e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp AND e1.activity = e2.activity WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_log e3 WHERE e3.idcase = e1.idcase AND e3.timestamp > e1.timestamp AND e3.timestamp < e2.timestamp )
